entries.subject: Layered XYZ galaxy point bake
entries.finding: Rejected during development because point depth quantization and cross-axis transitions reduced point sharpness. Current renderer batches projected catalogue points and uses separate covariance count clouds. This consolidates the recorded implementation decision, not a new benchmark.
entries.revisitWhen: A matched rotation benchmark demonstrates sharper stable points at the same bounded rendering cost.
